repository.name: @webex/plugin-messages
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.messages that manages Webex messages through the Webex REST API messages resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs a message and update PUTs a replacement payload that must carry a roomId, each sent as a JSON body or, when the files array holds a blob or buffer, as a multipart formData upload; get and remove take a message object or id, and list resolves a webex-core Page. listen() builds a webhook-style event envelope, connects the Mercury socket, and turns conversation activities with the verbs post and share into created events carrying the message fetched again from Hydra, and delete activities into deleted events built from the activity. Importing the package also registers the conversation and mercury internal plugins. Nothing is cached or persisted.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-messages package entry
public_interfaces.audience: SDK bundles (webex, webex-node) and applications that build their own webex instance
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers the internal plugins conversation (whose payload transformer decrypts socket activities) and mercury, then Messages as public plugin 'messages' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The default export Messages is the only export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.messages methods and events
public_interfaces.audience: applications, @webex/test-webex-node, and the workspace samples browser-socket and browser-read-status
public_interfaces.notes: create, update, get, list, and remove send one hydra messages request each; list resolves a webex-core Page and remove resolves undefined on 204. create and update send multipart formData when files holds a non-string entry, else a JSON body, and both mutate their arguments. update logs an error and returns null, not a promise, when neither argument has a roomId. listen() needs spark:all and spark:kms; each call adds another Mercury listener. Verbs post and share give created (data fetched from hydra), delete gives deleted; there is no updated event. fire, onWebexApiEvent, and getMessageEvent are marked @private.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: build runs build:src, which writes dist. There is no test:unit script and no unit test. test:integration (commands.integration-test) runs mocha over test/integration/spec, whose cases all sit inside describe.skip (0 passing, 14 pending, exit 0). test:browser (commands.browser-test) runs karma over the same spec but bundles nothing today (no case run, exit 0). The aggregate test script runs test:style, then exits 1 because test:unit is not defined; it is deliberately not a manifest command.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not build Hydra ids by hand or with a fixed cluster.
negative_guidance.why: Event ids must match the ids the messages resource returns (INV-004).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not choose a JSON body or multipart formData differently in create and update.
negative_guidance.why: Both follow one rule: formData exactly when files holds a non-string entry (INV-001).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not send an update without a roomId in the payload.
negative_guidance.why: The REST API requires it, per the code comment in update (INV-002).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not fill an event without deep-cloning the stored envelope.
negative_guidance.why: One envelope is shared by every event (INV-005).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log message text, files, ids, or email addresses through webex.logger.
negative_guidance.why: They identify users and carry their content; only two fixed lines are logged today.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the behavior reference.
negative_guidance.why: It shows only get(id); see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold or a unit-test command for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No unit test, test:unit script, coverage script, or threshold exists.
